This document creates some more focused plots for the data calculated in 01_iucn_aquax_eez_overlap_db.qmd and 02_iucn_aquax_rangearea.qmd. It saves figures for RCP 4.5 2050 and the 1 pixel threshold data.

## EEZs

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
globe <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r}
eez <- st_read('/home/shares/usgs-cap-rangeshifts/spatial/World_EEZ_v12_20231025_gpkg/eez_v12.gpkg')
```

```{r}
eez <- st_read('/Users/abowd/World_EEZ_v12_20231025_gpkg/eez_v12.gpkg')
```

```{r}
# Get list of EEZ IDs that are not overlapping claims (i.e., POL_TYPE = 200NM)
eez_200nm_list <- eez %>% 
  filter(POL_TYPE == "200NM") %>% 
  pull(MRGID)

# Add Ukraine to list
eez_200nm_list <- c(eez_200nm_list, 5695)
```

```{r}
# Get list of EEZs that are not POL_TYPE = 200NM
eez_contested_list <- eez %>% 
  filter(POL_TYPE != "200NM") %>%
  # Remove Ukraine from this list
  filter(MRGID != 5695) %>% 
  pull(MRGID)
```

```{r}
eez_simple <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME, SOVEREIGN1, TERRITORY1, ISO_TER1, ISO_SOV1, MRGID_SOV1, MRGID_TER1) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list) %>% 
  # For the territories that don't have ISO or IDs (like HI and AK), assign to SOV 
  mutate(MRGID_TER1 = ifelse(is.na(ISO_TER1), MRGID_SOV1, MRGID_TER1),
        ISO_TER1 = ifelse(is.na(ISO_TER1), ISO_SOV1, ISO_TER1))

eez_simple_sf <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME) %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list)
```

```{r}
eez_contested_sf <- eez %>% 
  dplyr::select(MRGID, GEONAME) %>% 
  filter(MRGID %in% eez_contested_list)
```

## Future - Current species (new species per pixel)
Only for the species entering the EEZs of that basin

```{r}
# Try applying species entries / exits by territories and sovereign EEZ
eez_spp_pxls_long_sov <- left_join(spp_eez_pxl_count %>% filter(MRGID %in% eez_200nm_list), eez_simple) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_RCP"),
               names_to = "scenario",
               values_to = "pxl_count") %>% 
  mutate(scenario = str_remove(scenario, "n_")) %>% 
  # Replace NA with 0, otherwise will be assigned to "continued presence"
  mutate(pxl_count = replace_na(pxl_count, 0),
         n_current = replace_na(n_current, 0)) %>% 
  # Group by territory and sovereign EEZ to calcualte species entry and exit
  group_by(ISO_TER1, MRGID_TER1, ISO_SOV1, scenario, aphiaid) %>% 
  summarize(sum_n_current = sum(n_current),
            sum_pxl_count = sum(pxl_count)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(spp_change = case_when(sum_n_current < 1 &  sum_pxl_count >= 1 ~ 'entry into new',
                            sum_n_current >= 1  & sum_pxl_count < 1 ~ 'exit from historical',
                            sum_n_current < 1  & sum_pxl_count < 1 ~ 'no presence',
                            TRUE ~ 'continued presence'))
```

```{r}
eez_simple_seaofjapan <- eez_simple %>% 
    filter(MRGID %in% c(8328, 8327, 8487, 5690, 48955))
```

```{r}
# Sea of Japan EEZs (MRGID 8328, 8327, 8487, 5690) under RCP4.5 in 2050 (tricky with Russia being such a large EEZ)
# Add contested Liancourt Rocks to Sea of Japan (48955) now 104 species
sea_japan_entry_spp <- eez_spp_pxls_long_sov %>% 
  filter(MRGID_TER1 %in% c(8601, 2121, 8600, 2240, 48935)) %>%
  filter(scenario == "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  filter(spp_change == "entry into new") 

```

# Read in AquaX files 

```{r}
# read in meta data on the aquax species
load("/home/shares/data-aquax/META_02122025.Rdata")
```

```{r}
meta_clean <- META %>% 
  mutate(worms_name = tolower(ScientificName)) %>% 
  select(!ScientificName) %>% 
  # simplify for now for easier viewing
  select(AphiaID, SPID, worms_name, GROUP, NR_CR, range_pixels, SDM)
```

```{r}
spp_fs <- list.files('/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM',
                     full.names = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(f = spp_fs) %>%
    mutate(fsize = file.size(f),
           aphiaid = str_extract(basename(f), '[0-9]+') %>% as.integer()) %>%
    left_join(META, by = c('aphiaid' = 'AphiaID'))
```

## Sea of Japan - entry species 
Plot the current range of the species entering the Sea of Japan region

```{r}
# Get aphiaids for the reef building corals entering Sea of Japan
sea_japan_aphiaid <- unique(sea_japan_entry_spp$aphiaid)
```

```{r}
df_sea_japan <- df %>% 
  filter(aphiaid %in% sea_japan_aphiaid)

```

We can use the function for new species pixels to map the range change for the species entering the EEZs of the Sea of Japan

```{r}
# Load functions for processing AquaX data
source(here( "common_fxns.R"))
```

```{r}
# 86 seconds
system.time({
  sea_japan_pxl_rcp45_2050_list <- parallel::mclapply(sea_japan_aphiaid, 
                                       FUN = extract_all_exit_pixels_df_db, 
                                       df = df_sea_japan, 
                                       s = "RCP45_2050",
                                       mc.cores = 5)
})
```

```{r}
exit_rcp45_df <- bind_rows(spp_exit_pxl_rcp45_2050_list) %>% 
  # drop entry = 0 (no entry pixels for aphiaid)
  filter(exit == 1)
```

```{r}
# Sum by XY cell, using collapse
system.time({
exit_rcp45_sum_df <- exit_rcp45_df %>% 
  fgroup_by(x, y) %>% 
  fcount() %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "RCP45_2050") %>% 
  rename(n_exit_pxls = N)
})
```
